item.title: Tenderlove Closes Rails World with a Counterpoint to DHH

item.title: Hanami, Why?: Introductions
item.description: I mentioned in my Hello, world! post that I built this site using Hanami. This site may seem simple on the surface; it is, after all, just a blog. However, the backend is packed with features that help me day to day. (2 sources: lobsters, rubyweekly)
